name: Openclaw-Study-Coach
tagline_zh: 一个有意思的技能：Openclaw-Study-Coach。英文简介见下。
desc_en: "How did that passage make you feel?" — the kid is stuck and the parent can't explain it either. It splits those questions into four steps: restate the question, go back to the text for evidence, offer a toolbox of options, assemble the answer. It never writes the answer.
